assessed_concepts: Original source task: Describe how predictive modelling using decision trees can help predict programming errors.
Describe how a supervised decision tree could classify a new software test run as likely to fail or likely to pass

markscheme.marking_summary: Train on labelled past runs with input features and pass/fail outcomes. The tree learns feature-based splits; the new run follows the applicable decisions to a leaf that provides a class prediction. Evaluate on independent labelled examples.
